seoCopy: Midnight Grace is a restrained black blouse design with delicate maroon and antique-gold Aari embroidery, subtle scattered motifs and matching neckline and sleeve borders. Its listed work type includes Aari embroidery, gold threadwork and bead embellishment; the exact thread fibre and bead composition can be discussed before ordering. The dark base makes the metallic and maroon details visible without relying on dense coverage. Consider pairing it with a black, maroon, antique-gold or deep red saree, checking the zari, pallu and jewellery together for a balanced result. The listed starting price is ₹1,999 for hand embroidery on a customer-supplied blouse or garment. It excludes the garment, courier and any additional material changes beyond the listed design. Send the event date, garment readiness and any requested changes with your enquiry so the studio can review the scope and confirm a realistic crafting timeline based on current workload. The finished blouse suits receptions, festive dinners and evening functions where quiet detail is preferred.
summary: An elegant black blouse featuring delicate maroon and antique-gold Aari embroidery with subtle scattered motifs.
description: Midnight Grace brings understated elegance through a deep black fabric base, intricate maroon and antique-gold embroidery, and delicate scattered embellishments. The neckline features a beautifully detailed embroidered border, complemented by matching sleeve borders and subtle metallic motifs across the blouse. The back showcases a wide U-shaped neckline with decorative tie strings and tassel detailing.

faqs.q: What occasion is Midnight Grace best for?
faqs.a: Receptions, evening functions and festive dinners where you want quiet detail rather than heavy coverage. The black base lets the maroon and antique-gold work show up under evening light without looking loud.

faqs.q: Which sarees go well with Midnight Grace?
faqs.a: Black, maroon, antique gold and deep red silk are the easiest matches. A Kanchipuram with a thin gold border keeps the look understated. Send us a daylight photo of your saree and we will check the shade before you confirm.

faqs.q: Is the work light enough to wear for a whole evening?
faqs.a: Yes. Coverage is light: scattered motifs, a neckline border and matching sleeve borders, so the blouse stays comfortable through a long function.

faqs.q: Can you change the colours or motifs on Midnight Grace?
faqs.a: Yes. Most brides change something: the thread colour to match their saree, a denser or lighter fill, or a different neckline and sleeve finish. Send your saree photo on WhatsApp and we will tell you what works and whether it changes the price.

faqs.q: How do I order Midnight Grace?
faqs.a: Tap WhatsApp or Make It Yours and send your saree photo and event date. We confirm the design, price, courier charge and delivery date. You pay a 50% advance, courier your blouse to our Trichy studio, and we send it back by tracked courier once the work is done.
